entities.name: Elamon
entities.description: A human hero and Mausoleum Guard from Hanweir, Innistrad, Torens's older brother and the family's provider.

entities.name: Torens
entities.description: Elamon's rebellious younger brother, who fled his pursuit and read Elamon's letter too late.

entities.name: Hanweir
entities.description: Town on Innistrad that became an Eldrazi ooze incorporating all its villagers.

entities.name: Eldrazi ooze
entities.description: Horror Hanweir became, incorporating its villagers including Elamon and their mother.

events.summary: Elamon unexpectedly encounters Torens in Jorelda's Pub while searching for a contact in illicit dealings.
Elamon tries to apprehend Torens, who flees the pursuit.
events.quote: culminating in Torens fleeing from his brother’s pursuit

events.summary: Elamon sends Torens a letter pleading for him to return home over their mother's failing health.
events.quote: was a desperate plea for Torens to return home

events.summary: Hanweir becomes an Eldrazi ooze incorporating all its villagers, including Elamon and their mother; Torens finds the township gone.
events.quote: Torens later walked to his home and found the entire township gone.
